fact: Presidential Despacho 300/26 of 13 August 2026 authorised USD 28 million and opened the public tender for a national digital identity and e-signature platform meant to let citizens and companies electronically verify the identity of their customers, per PTI.
system: Plataforma Nacional de Identidade Digital e Assinaturas Electrónicas

fact: Tech By Tech, a private company, says its AngolaID digital identity wallet and verification service is available on Google Play and the App Store in test mode.
Tech By Tech's CEO says AngolaID has been in operation since 2024 and offers API and SDK verification, authentication and liveness checks to institutions.

Justice Minister Marcy Lopes says the Interior Ministry, prison services and the migration service are integrated with the ID database to confirm citizens' identity and check the validity of the Bilhete de Identidade for passport issuance.
